verdict_reason: Paths, the address-type start path and the per-tab list path match the ins-frontend; three Major code-quality findings: the added type and its role in two places, ADDRESS_BOOK not naming itself a path, and a doc comment that describes its caller.

todos.issue: The address type the suite adds with (ADDED_ADDRESS_TYPE, line 11) and the role it ticks ('PLACE_OF_ORIGIN', a literal in addAddressAnswers line 41) are one choice kept in two places. Change ADDED_ADDRESS_TYPE to, say, BRANCH and the ins-frontend drops the role the type does not offer (keepRolesOfferedBy, add.controller.js:351) then refuses the empty list (rolesErrorsOf, :340), so every add answers 400.
todos.fix: Must: the role the suite ticks comes from the same definition as the type it adds with, so changing one cannot leave the other wrong. One way: define the added type and its role together (e.g. ADDED_ADDRESS = { addressType: ORIGIN_OR_CONSIGNOR, role: 'PLACE_OF_ORIGIN' }) and read both from it.

todos.issue: ADDRESS_BOOK holds the path '/address-book', but its name does not say path, while its sibling ADDRESS_TYPE_START_PATH (line 9) does; front-door.js imports it next to TRAFFIC_CLASSES.ADDRESS_BOOK, which is the traffic class 'address-book', so one name reads as two different values in the same module.
todos.fix: Must: the constant's name says it is the address book's path. One way: rename to ADDRESS_BOOK_PATH and update front-door.js, readiness.js and addressIdFrom/addressBookListPath.

todos.issue: The ADDRESS_BOOK_SESSION_ENDPOINTS doc comment describes its caller, not the constant: 'A session makes all of them when its worst-case search is chosen' (line 16) narrates addressBookSession in k6/front-door.js. The house rule says a comment describes only the lines below it.
todos.fix: Must: the doc comment states only what the constant holds. One way: keep 'The endpoint name of each address-book request after the dashboard, one entry per request' and delete the sentence about what a session does.
